USCGC 𝘔𝘢𝘤𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘸 (WAGB-83) shines in the summer sunlight in Mackinaw City, Michigan, where it is preserved as a museum. The 𝘔𝘢𝘤𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘸 was built during WWII to help extend the shipping season on the Great Lakes, and served as an icebreaker until it's retirement in 2006.

USCG-SUNDEW (WLB-404) was my berth for a week. Snagging buoys as big as cars out of Lake Superior, standing watch above the Bridge (Blue Canvas in photo) under countless stars. All to write songs. Come hear a few April 20 in Dinkytown! Photo: USCG Tickets: events.humanitix.com/charliemaguire
